looks.title: Roof cathedral
looks.intent: The hall's own architecture lit as a nave: every column-base beam rises straight up into the space frame in mirrored pairs, a slight lean in toward the centre line; the booth's beams open as an apse fan into the lantern above the press; the tower bee-eyes lift low over the house; the DJ keyed from both sides.

looks.title: Fan out
looks.intent: The booth's beams open in one symmetric fan over the house from behind the DJ; the column rows lean back toward the booth so every beam in the room reads from the machinery outward; the tower bee-eyes fan wide and low.

looks.title: Crossfire
looks.intent: The two column rows fire across the dance floor at each other and cross over the nave's centre line at 9 m; the four beams behind the DJ X-cross 12 m over the booth, the flank beams over the front of the crowd; the tower bee-eyes cross just in front of the barrier.

looks.title: All to centre
looks.intent: The ballyhoo focus, 16 m out from the booth, 9 m up: the flank beams, the bee-eyes and the column rows meet there (the booth's lamps over the booth's axis, the column rows over the nave's, 1.65 m apart — the booth is centred on the press, not on the hall); the four beams behind the DJ meet higher, 13 m straight over the booth, so none crosses the DJ.

looks.title: Curtain
looks.intent: A wall of light behind the DJ: the booth's beams stand straight up in front of the machinery, the tower bee-eyes straight up either side, the header spots straight down onto the booth; the column rows lean back to the booth.
